dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Have you met young women these days?  If I was a young man, I wouldn't want to date them either.

@dogecoin_empire I specifically choose seats (and pay more for them) with more leg room, or for a whole list of other reasons having to do with my disability and how uncomfortable it is to sit for extended periods of time.  If they wanted to sit together, they should have booked seats together.
@dogecoin_empire I would love you forever if you gave me a potted basil, sage, or thyme plant.

@dogecoin_empire Nope.  Garage doors have are TERRIBLE at keeping the heat/cold out.  You'd fry in the summer even with air-conditioning, and freeze in the winter even with heating.  I'd also need more space for my physical media collection and exercise equipment.
